name: wermaid
description: Manual layout overrides for vanilla Mermaid: keep the auto layout, nudge what needs it. Loads from a CDN (jsDelivr) with no build step: custom themes and an embeddable, editable <wermaid-diagram>.

scripts.test: node test/run.mjs test/m1.html && node test/interact.mjs && node test/export.mjs && node test/embed.mjs && node test/features.mjs && node test/watch.mjs
